description: This PHP class defines styling options specifically for cell alignment in the PhpSpreadsheet library, including properties and methods for setting horizontal and vertical alignment, text rotation, wrapping, indentation, and read order.

classes.name: Alignment
classes.description: Represents the vertical and horizontal alignment styles for cell content, providing methods to get/set alignment properties and apply styles within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared alignment component for the active cell in the current sheet, used for style supervisors.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds an array representing style components, used internally to apply style settings.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an array to the alignment object.

methods.name: getHorizontal
methods.description: Returns the current horizontal alignment setting.

methods.name: getVertical
methods.description: Returns the current vertical alignment setting.

methods.name: getTextRotation
methods.description: Returns the current text rotation angle.

methods.name: setTextRotation
methods.description: Sets the text rotation angle, with validation.

methods.name: getWrapText
methods.description: Returns whether text wrapping is enabled.

methods.name: getShrinkToFit
methods.description: Returns whether shrinking to fit is enabled.

methods.name: setShrinkToFit
methods.description: Enables or disables shrinking to fit.

methods.name: setIndent
methods.description: Sets the indent level, with limitations based on horizontal alignment.

methods.name: getReadOrder
methods.description: Returns the current reading order setting.

methods.name: setReadOrder
methods.description: Sets the reading order, with validation.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash of the current style state for comparison purposes.
